'''thehooky I Must Be Allowed To Cheet!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[thehooky]]
* '''Published:''' 10 December 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8)|VS8O-05-Careful_Planning.png|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' I Must Be Allowed To Cheet!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS8 IMBATC thehooky LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Careful Planning (V), Wokling (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Redemption (V), Tawss Khaa (V), Chewbacca (V), Obi-Wan Kenobi (V), Tantive IV (V), Bright Hope (V), Bionic Hand (V), Krayt Dragon Howl (V), Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy (V), The Time For Our Attack Has Come (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Notes ==

* Headers: starting says 8 but lists 9 cards (Redemption (V) is in the starting list) and Ships says 6 but lists 5; the list totals 60.
* Virtual Set 8 printings used because the post marks them virtual and they have no VS1-7 printing: Careful Planning (V), Krayt Dragon Howl (V), The Time For Our Attack Has Come (V). Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) has VS1 and VS8 printings; dested VS8 since the post already uses VS8 cards (Dec 2004).
* No objective: starts Watto's Junkyard, City Outskirts and Tatooine with An Unusual Amount Of Fear. Super lando dested Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel; Tatooine Qui-Gon Jinn x2 with Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Reflections III) as posted 'qhi-gons lightsaber'.
* Other (V) cards: Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (VS1); Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy (V) (VS2); Wokling (V), Chewbacca (V) (VS3); Redemption (V), Bright Hope (V), Bionic Hand (V) (VS6); Tawss Khaa (V), Tantive IV (V) (VS7).
* Posted 'tat:docking bay' dested Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay: the strategy places it with Watto's Junkyard and City Outskirts, and it is the more flexible site for this deck (reviewed by Bill).

== Strategy ==

there are almost to many red cards! destiny is rather hi in the deck, and there are so many destiny adders its crazy!

its a rather simple deck and your activation is crazy!

turn 1 pull up the docking bay and the farm, put the docking bay betwean the junkyard and the outskirts, use wokling V to pull secure route, draw.

you need to get some one to the docking bay and deploy secure route there, so you can get your majer drains started early! deploy any warrior to the junkyard, my self i like leia there alone with the saber, light saber pro, meditation and warriors courage! wich is all pull able. she will have three battle destiny and she will make some one forfit zero! i must be allowed to speek is very good with this deck becouse i activate so much force and then i git to look through my used pile and dig stuff up!

just play your game and get those drains going fast. if they come to you then clear the site with sabers and as many destiny adders as you can! if they are playing Carbon freeze then pull han with chewbaca V and lose him to a drain or something, if you free han then you will get him back for free any way.

please let me know if i can do any thing to make this deck better. thanks for all your time.
